summary: Closing consolidation for this run, plus one durable correction: the Behavior 0b99111e65eb4d9faae97028d6140ff5-knowledge-0 is revised to revision 4 so it cites the retained backlog receipt (CheckRun 62f089bd843641099558ff8d8831ab29, indices 35 and 43) instead of describing that evidence as a local run; its substantive content is unchanged — compactLogsWithTrailing makes the retained log begin above the snapshot index only when lastLogIdx − trailingLogs >= snapshotIndex at snapshot time, which is necessary but not sufficient, since the backlog case met it (snapshot at index 4, store 5..63) and the peer still converged with zero snapshot installs at applied index 64. The consolidation records what stands asserted, each on its executed basis: a follower that installed a snapshot for (L,T) yet advertises an earlier term for L rejects the leader's boundary append (CheckRun 72367650c8d0470d8197a7d2c0f97ce1); with TrailingLogs=0 and a snapshot taken at the log end the leader cannot repair such a follower and re-sends the whole snapshot while its applied index stays pinned at the snapshot index (single-peer witness CheckRun 7772ad1b5b154d498a27a79806bb0ea7 and sealed-partition witness CheckRun f66fa4e4e0514f7e95b7788032144a30); and retention depth at snapshot time is the load-bearing difference for the non-zero cases (control CheckRun beca431464bf44ab9c3354145c21899f). It also records what was refuted or narrowed (the incomplete-partition artifact with its in-place Fact revision, the

reading, and the sufficiency of the compaction condition) and what remains open (the backlog peer's unexplained repair path, plausibly its own snapshotting under the shared small SnapshotThreshold; the default TrailingLogs=10240 case with a matching backlog, never executed; and the older registered gaps answered only in prose because their ids were not resolvable for formal answers). It flags the one record inconsistency for reviewers — 7465f7b9e6cd44e39e8cbf7e2c45c955-interpretation-0 still reads as refuting the loop for the five-node history, while its Fact was revised and the lineage entry explains that the refutation applied only to the incomplete-partition harness — and states the honest limits: only TrailingLogs=0 with a snapshot at the log end has a demonstrated unrepairable-follower loop, everything is in-process five-node in-memory, and human review owns final defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication. Structural validation returned valid=true.
